arxiv-2103-16429.title: Put Chatbot into Its Interlocutor’s Shoes: New Framework to Learn Chatbot Responding with Intention
arxiv-2103-16429.creator: Hsuan Su, Jiun-Hao Jhan, Fan-yun Sun, Saurav Sahay, Hung-yi Lee
arxiv-2103-16429.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hsuan Su, Jiun-Hao Jhan, Fan-yun Sun, Saurav Sahay, Hung-yi Lee. Most chatbot literature that focuses on improving the fluency and coherence of a chatbot, is dedicated to making chatbots more human-like. However, very little work delves into what really separates humans from chatbots – humans intrinsically understand the effect their responses have on the interlocutor and often respond with an intention such as proposing an optimistic view to make the interlocutor feel better.

arxiv-2312-02590.title: Text Intimacy Analysis using Ensembles of Multilingual Transformers
arxiv-2312-02590.creator: Tanmay Chavan, Ved Patwardhan
arxiv-2312-02590.description: Abstract Intimacy estimation of a given text has recently gained importance due to the increase in direct interaction of NLP systems with humans. Intimacy is an important aspect of natural language and has a substantial impact on our everyday communication. Thus the level of intimacy can provide us with deeper insights and richer semantics of conversations.

arxiv-2602-10076.title: Orbital piezomagnetic polarizability of pure insulating altermagnets in two dimensions
arxiv-2602-10076.creator: Beryl Bell, J. W. F. Venderbos
arxiv-2602-10076.description: Abstract The distinctive symmetry properties of pure altermagnets make them natural candidates for piezomagnetism. Previous work motivated by the piezomagnetic properties of altermagnets has primarily focused on the spin magnetization response to applied strain. In this paper we study orbital piezomagnetic effects—the orbital magnetization response to applied strain—in minimal lattice models of pure insulating altermagnets in two dimensions.

pmc-10737953.title: IMPLEMENTATION AND EFFECTIVENESS OF VIRTUAL REALITY PROGRAMS IN LONG-TERM CARE SETTINGS
pmc-10737953.creator: Marie Savundranayagam, Kristine Williams
pmc-10737953.description: Virtual reality (VR) is an immersive technology that allows users to experience a computer-generated simulation of a three-dimensional environment. It is used in healthcare for education and training purposes, as therapeutic interventions, and for social engagement. However, there are few studies exploring the use of VR in long-term care settings.

pmc-12946481.title: Surgeons' Experiences After Surgical Errors: Insights From a Urology Department
pmc-12946481.creator: Ehsan Sepehran, Mohsen Amjadi, Neda Kabiri, Seyed Faraz Mortazavi, Shabnam Ghasemyani, Arash Mohagheghi, Farzin Soleimanzadeh
pmc-12946481.description: Background and AimsSurgical practice is rewarding but also challenging, and adverse patient events can deeply affect surgeons. In this study, we explored how such events influence surgeons' personal well‐being, emotional state, and professional performance.MethodsThis qualitative descriptive study was conducted using semi‐structured interviews with 13 urology faculty members and residents at Tabriz University of Medical Sciences, Tabriz, Iran.

pmc-13335134.title: ISG15 negatively regulates RIPK3-mediated cell death and viral pathogenesis
pmc-13335134.creator: Yi-Chieh Perng, Jessica MC Warsaw, Sachendra S Bais, Bradley E Hiller, Marissa C Locke, David J Morales-Heil, Chaoqun Li, Alissa R Young, Kristen J Monte, Robert E Schmidt, Douglas R Green, Yi-Nan Gong, Deborah J Lenschow
pmc-13335134.description: SUMMARYNecroptosis, a form of programmed, inflammatory necrosis, plays an important role in viral-host defense and inflammation. The receptor-interacting protein kinase 3 (RIPK3)/mixed lineage kinase domain-like pseudokinase (MLKL) pathway mediates necroptosis. Yet, the mechanisms that control necroptosis to limit immunopathology are poorly understood.

pmc-13679007.title: Childhood bullying and body dissatisfaction in adolescents from marginalised groups
pmc-13679007.creator: Marie-Christine Opitz, Nora Trompeter, Ulrike Schmidt, Nadia Micali, Helen Sharpe
pmc-13679007.description: BackgroundExperiences of being bullied have consistently been linked to body dissatisfaction. The present study aimed to investigate the longitudinal relationship between childhood bullying and body image outcomes in adolescents from two large UK-based cohorts. Analyses were conducted separately for marginalised groups to investigate unique risks.

uslaw-usc-t16-s410hhhh5.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s410hhhh5.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LIX–FFF (Jimmy Carter National Historical Park). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For the purposes of this subchapter— (1) the term “preservation district” means the Jimmy Carter National Preservation District established under section 410hhhh–1 of this title; (2) the term “historical park” means the Jimmy Carter National.
